messages:
leo: starting staged rollout v2.0.3 -> canary 10% (ap-south). change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. release notes live: https://redwood/release/v2.0.3 :tada:

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT r-3522 initiated. target=canary:10% ap-south. monitors: latency_p95, 502_rate, rerank-f1. streaming logs to /rollouts/r-3522. :robot_face:

tia: monitoring. quick sanity: smoke and integration tests green on canary pods.

ops_lead: call out if we see 502s or rerank drop > 6pp. autoscaler set to conservative ramp.

leo: seeing a small spike in 502s from one node pool (nodepool-b). 502 rate 0.8% -> 2.4% over 7m.

infra-bot: alert: nodepool-b health degraded, 3 pods restarted in 5m. investigating.

tia: also ran a small sample eval: rerank F1 went from 0.81 -> 0.72 on a subset of product-search prompts. not across entire corpus.

leo: logs snippet:
```
[02:12:01] svc-edge ap-south node-19 req=xyz timeout=read 502
[02:12:03] embed-worker node-19 oom_kill pid=4245
[02:12:05] reranker: score_drop detected avg=0.72 baseline=0.81
```

ops_lead: suggested action: freeze rollout (stop further traffic), cordon nodepool-b from canary, and kick off targeted eval across the top-100 queries. can we pin the rollout?

deploy-bot: command: `deploy-bot pin r-3522 --note \"nodepool-b 502s + rerank drift\"` -> done. state=paused_at_10pct. audit: pinned by ops_lead at 3522223450.

leo: pin acknowledged. I'm cordoning nodepool-b from the canary set via infra play: `infractl exclude-nodepool --name nodepool-b --rollout r-3522`

infra-bot: nodepool-b excluded from canary routing. live canary capacity now on nodepool-a and nodepool-c.

cs-ops: CS notified: \"Canary v2.0.3 paused in ap-south due to intermittent 502s and ranking regression. We'll update after eval.\"

tia: kicked off eval job ev-901 (top-100 queries + long-tail). ETA ~12m.

ops_lead: contingency: if ev-901 shows rerank F1 delta >= 5pp or 502s don't stabilize within 15m, plan to rollback to v2.0.2. rollback command reviewed: `deploy-bot rollback r-3522 --to v2.0.2 --notify cs-ops@redwood`

leo: small note — infra team has a tiny kernel/pagecache tweak queued that might resolve node restarts. if eval looks marginal, we could try redeploying canary with that tweak limited to one region. prefer rollback if quality impact is clear.

eval-bot: ev-901 completed. results: top-100 pass_rate=88% baseline=94% delta=-6pp. long-tail sample pass_rate=91% baseline=93% delta=-2pp. full report: https://redwood/evals/ev-901 - flagged as regression per policy.

ops_lead: decision time. ev-901 flags rerank regression exceeding threshold on top queries. recommend rollback to v2.0.2 within change window. any objections?

tia: agree with rollback. the node restarts make it risky to keep ramping.

leo: rolling back now. please run rollback command and notify infra and CS.

deploy-bot: executing rollback: `deploy-bot rollback r-3522 --to v2.0.2 --notify \"cs-ops@redwood\" --reason \"502s + rerank regression\"`

deploy-bot: rollback complete. traffic reverted to v2.0.2. state=rolled_back. audit: rollback by leo at 3522223596.

infra-bot: nodepool-b remediation ticket created: TKT-998. suggested follow-ups: reproduce OOM, check model memory tuning, apply kernel tweak in canary staging.

ops_lead: post-rollback checklist: capture failing top-100 queries, reproduce on staging with nodepool-b setup, vet kernel tweak in staging, and run ev-901 after patch. schedule 1:1 with infra and ML-ops at 05:00 UTC.

cs-ops: customer note posted and queued to send: \"We paused v2.0.3 canary due to intermittent service errors and ranking regressions; traffic reverted to v2.0.2. We'll follow up with a timeline once root cause is confirmed.\"

leo: thanks everyone. closing this rollout thread. we'll reopen when remediation validated. :white_check_mark:
